data.title: Intralesional vinblastine
data.category: More from Khopkar · Wart & antiviral agents
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Wart & antiviral agents_

**Class:** Vinca alkaloid (antimitotic)

## Mechanism of action
- Binds tubulin → blocks microtubule assembly → mitotic arrest

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Kaposi sarcoma (localised lesions) — intralesional; warts (rarely)
- Systemic: lymphomas, Langerhans cell histiocytosis

## Dose & formulations
- Intralesional 0.1–0.5 mg/mL (0.1 mL per 0.5 cm² lesion) every 2–3 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Pain at injection site, hyperpigmentation, ulceration; systemic: neuropathy, marrow suppression; extravasation necrosis

## Contraindications
- Pregnancy; IV only for systemic use (intrathecal fatal)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Contraindicated.

## Viva points
- Intralesional vinblastine for Kaposi sarcoma

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.47; Khopkar (intralesional agents). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
